tweets.text:
We're adding a new plugin to Claude Code: You should Know.

It scans Claude's output for important information you might miss to help keep you in the loop.

Enable it with:

/plugin enable cc-plugin-you-should-know@builtin

"You should know" is a mod that works by spinning off a sideagent to observe Claude's output.

Read more about mods in our newest blog post: https://claude.dev/blog/getting-started-with-claude-code-mods/

Lots of inventive things made with Claude these past few weeks. A few of our favorites:

A working watermill, built with Opus 5.5.
Embossed cards, made with Opus 5.5.
A 3D site that flies you from outside the Milky Way down to Jupiter’s moons, Opus 5.5.
Water, simulated in the browser.
Poems, illustrated in Claude Code.
Claude Code and a camera, left running overnight on Old Street.
A pixel walk through Seattle that follows the real weather and time of day.
A pop-up city where each building is a paper fold drawn on a flat canvas, Sonnet 5.5.
A jet engine in interactive 3D you can cut away and pull apart, made with Opus 5.5.
What are you exploring with Claude this weekend?

You can now mod Claude Code:

- Change how it behaves
- Customize the UI
- Swap in your own features

Write one with a few lines of TypeScript, or have Claude build it for you. Mods ship inside plugins, so you install them with /plugin in the CLI or desktop app.

A few examples:
Token Weather adds a forecast of your context window: how full it is, plus a sparkline of your last 12 turns.
Blast Radius catches risky shell commands like rm -rf, git reset --hard, or a force push before they run. It shows what the command would touch in a side pane.
Replay Theater records every file edit Claude makes in a turn. Run /replay to step through the diffs one at a time in a docked pane.

Keep mods to yourself, or submit them to the Claude directory if others might find them useful. Mods run with the same access to your machine as Claude Code itself, so make sure to only install mods from sources you trust.

https://claude.ai/directory

We're adding pre-built sample mods to the Claude Code Playground repo you can riff off of, if you need some inspiration.

Learn more in our getting started guide: https://claude.dev/blog/getting-started-with-claude-code-mods/

We’ve used mods to build features like /diff and AGENTS.md support. We hope you find them as useful (and fun) as we do, and can't wait to see what you build!

https://claude.com/blog/claude-code-mods

For two weeks, start a design, deck, or doc in the Claude app, and the work that follows in that conversation uses 50% less of your usage limits.

Give it a try with Claude Sonnet 5.5. It has a strong eye for design and builds slides that need minimal editing.

Applies automatically each time you create a design, deck, or doc, and runs through October 15 on Pro, Max, and Team plans.

How it works and full terms: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17274727
